S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  10.05.2023 AO No. 179 of 2023  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The challenge in the present Appeal, filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is to an Award dated 29.03.2023, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ Ist Additional District Judge, Udham Singh Nagar in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 308 of 2019, "Smt. Meenakshi Devi and Another vs. Uttarakhand Transport Corporation Depot Tanakpur District Champawat and Others", by which, learned Tribunal has passed an Award of Rs. 21,33,824/-, as compensation along with an interest at the rate of 6 percent per annum from the date of Petition till its actual payment.
2.

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Shobhit Joshi, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for the appellant.

5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6.
7. Learned counsel for the appellant requested four weeks' time to deposit Rs. 15,00,000/- (Rupees fifteen lakh) before the Tribunal concerned.

8. Subject to deposit of Rs. 15,00,000/- (Rupees fifteen lakh) within four weeks from today before Tribunal concerned, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 29.03.2023 are stayed till further order.
9.
Stay Application (IA No. 1 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.
